content:
A **Cryo Mine** is a thrown weapon in *Fallout 76*.

Upon explosion, the Cryo Mine has a chance to temporarily slow wounded targets that managed to survive the initial blast.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Acid (2) Adhesive (2) Aluminum (2) cryo Cell (2) Nuclear Material (2) Spring (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Plan: Cryo mine | | Cryo Mine (1) | 

- Can be awarded by Lucky Lou after he returns to Crater Core from Carleton Mine.
- Can randomly spawn at locations across Appalachia.
- Can randomly spawn on Corpses and in Explosives Crates.
- Can randomly be sold by Vendors.
